title: Privacy Policy
description: How information is handled when you use the We Paint Siding website.

sections.title: About this notice
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy explains the current We Paint Siding website, including quote drafts, hosting and embedded services. Details shared in a separate business relationship or through another provider may be handled under the notices and arrangements supplied for that channel.

sections.title: Quote request drafts
paragraphs: The quote tools collect the project details you enter, such as name, contact information, location and surfaces to be painted. Those values are processed in your browser to create a downloadable text draft. The tools do not transmit the entries to We Paint Siding or submit an enquiry.

A downloaded draft stays on your device until you delete it. Form values can remain in the open page or be remembered by your browser’s autofill. Include only useful project information; avoid payment details, identification records or other sensitive material in the description.

sections.title: Newsletter and accounts
paragraphs: Newsletter registration is currently inactive. Subscribe shows a status message without adding the entered email to a mailing list. The website also does not offer customer accounts or process online payments.

sections.title: Technical information and hosting
paragraphs: Vercel hosts the website. Serving and protecting pages can involve technical request information, including IP addresses and browser or request details, being processed by the hosting provider. The application itself has no configured advertising tracker or analytics integration.
Provider records and retention depend on the service and its configuration. This policy does not specify a guaranteed retention period or processing location for the hosting provider’s information.

sections.title: Maps and external services
paragraphs: Some service and location pages contain Google Maps embeds. Loading a map connects the browser to Google, which may handle technical information and cookies or related technologies under its policies. Existing sessions, browser settings and map interactions can affect that processing.
External sites have their own privacy notices. The website’s fonts and image assets are served with the site; they are not requested from an external font library.

sections.title: Your choices
paragraphs: You can avoid entering details in quote tools, delete downloaded drafts and manage autofill or cookies through your browser. Browser controls may also restrict third-party content, including maps; choosing a page without an embed avoids loading that map.
If you share information through an established business contact channel, ask about the purpose and handling through that channel, including any available options to access or correct your details.

sections.title: Privacy enquiries
paragraphs: Send privacy questions through an established We Paint Siding contact channel supplied to you separately. The website quote tool only downloads a local draft; it does not transmit a privacy request or confirm that the business has received one.

sections.title: Changes to this notice
paragraphs: This notice should be reviewed when submissions, subscriptions, accounts, tracking or other features change. The date shown above identifies the current version of the website policy.

title: Cookies Policy
description: Cookies, browser storage and third-party services on this website.

sections.title: What cookies are
paragraphs: Cookies are small records a website or provider asks a browser to store. Other browser technologies can also hold information or help a service recognise a request. Their use depends on the service and your browser settings.

sections.title: Current website features
paragraphs: The website application does not currently set advertising cookies, use an analytics integration or store marketing preferences in local storage. Menu panels, article filters and comparison sliders keep their current state within the open page.
Quote tools produce a downloaded draft, and newsletter registration is inactive. These application features do not create an advertising profile or register you on a mailing list.

sections.title: Hosting and embedded maps
paragraphs: Vercel can process technical requests while delivering and protecting the site. Embedded Google Maps connects to Google when loaded and may involve cookies or similar technologies. Existing provider cookies can also accompany requests according to your browser’s settings.
Third-party behaviour can depend on account sessions, browser settings, location and provider changes. This notice does not state that the site can never involve third-party cookies.

sections.title: Managing browser settings
paragraphs: Review your browser’s privacy or site settings to inspect, remove or restrict stored data and third-party cookies. The available options vary by device and browser. Blocking third-party services may prevent embedded maps from working as expected.
Browser cookie controls do not delete quote drafts already downloaded to your device. Remove those files separately if you no longer want to keep them.

sections.title: Future changes and questions
paragraphs: If tracking or features that use additional browser storage are introduced, this notice and the available choices will need review. The Privacy Policy explains the current forms, hosting and external services in more detail.

title: Disclaimer
description: Important context for website guides, imagery and project information.

sections.title: General website information
paragraphs: Service pages and guides provide general painting and planning information. They cannot assess every property, material, previous finish or coating system. Review your own surfaces with a qualified professional and confirm a written scope before deciding what work should proceed.

sections.title: Illustrative images and comparisons
paragraphs: The website includes generated illustrative photographs. Before and after sliders present colour-change concepts rather than documented client work, unless an individual image is clearly identified otherwise.

Example descriptions demonstrate possible project goals, surfaces and scope. They do not identify a customer’s property, verify completed results or promise an identical outcome at another home or business.

sections.title: Colours and finishes
paragraphs: Displays, lighting and materials affect the appearance of paint colours. A screen image may differ from a physical sample or finished surface. Review suitable samples and confirm colour, sheen and product choices in your project details.

sections.title: Quotes, schedules and warranties
paragraphs: Website information does not constitute an individual quote, booking or warranty. Confirm preparation, coverage, products, price, schedule and any applicable terms in your own written agreement. A downloaded quote draft has not been submitted or accepted by the business.

sections.title: Third-party resources
paragraphs: External links and maps are offered as reference tools. Providers can change their content and services, which operate under their own terms and notices. A link on this website does not guarantee a third party’s information or performance.

sections.title: Questions about a project
paragraphs: Use the painting guides and service descriptions to prepare questions. Resolve uncertain details with the people handling your actual project before preparation or application begins.

title: Terms and Conditions
description: Terms for browsing and using the We Paint Siding website.

sections.title: Website purpose
paragraphs: The website introduces We Paint Siding services and offers general painting guides. These browsing terms do not define a painting project’s scope or replace the agreement made separately for that work.

sections.title: Responsible use
paragraphs: Use the site lawfully and without disrupting its operation. Do not bypass security, attempt unauthorised access to information or provide misleading details through the website’s features.

sections.title: Content and imagery
paragraphs: Text, branding, layout and imagery are supplied to help visitors understand the site and its services. Illustrative concepts must not be represented as your own documented project work. Third-party material remains subject to the rights and licences that apply to it.

sections.title: Enquiries and service agreements
paragraphs: The quote tool generates a draft file on your device. It does not submit an enquiry, book work or create a service contract. Newsletter registration is also not active.

Painting work requires separately agreed scope, preparation, products, access, timing, pricing and applicable terms. General descriptions on the website do not substitute for those project-specific details.

sections.title: Availability and external resources
paragraphs: Website pages or features can change and may be unavailable during maintenance. Embedded services and external sites have their own terms; review the relevant provider’s notices when using them.

sections.title: Information and questions
paragraphs: The Privacy Policy, Cookies Policy and Disclaimer describe the current features and the context of site information. These pages are not intended to exclude rights that cannot lawfully be removed.

title: Accessibility
description: Using the site and understanding its accessibility features.

sections.title: Our approach
paragraphs: We aim to provide clear, usable content across screen sizes. This accessibility page describes the site’s features; it does not certify complete conformance with any particular accessibility standard.

sections.title: Navigation and keyboard access
paragraphs: Use the Skip to content link at the start of a page to reach the main content. Tab and Shift+Tab move through controls. Service and location labels open their panels, and Escape dismisses an open dropdown.

Each panel contains a main-page link and links to the individual services or communities. Touch users can tap a category label to expand or collapse the panel, with the mobile menu opened through its Menu button.

sections.title: Reading and interactive content
paragraphs: Pages use headings, responsive layouts and descriptive image text. Article contents links reach the relevant sections. Blog search and topic filters update the visible articles and announce a result count.
Before and after comparisons use range inputs. Focus a slider and press arrow keys to adjust it; Home and End reach the endpoints. FAQ sections use native disclosures that can be opened and closed.

sections.title: Motion, zoom and third-party content
paragraphs: Reduced-motion preferences are respected for scrolling and transitions. Browser zoom and device text settings can be used to enlarge content. Google Maps embeds have provider-controlled interactions and may behave differently from the rest of the site.

sections.title: Reporting a barrier
paragraphs: When reporting a barrier, include the page, intended action and browser or assistive technology involved. Share that information through an established We Paint Siding contact channel. Saving a website quote draft does not send an accessibility report to the business.
